| Frostbite / Max Ranks: 5, [Elemental] / A Frostbitten creature suffers the effects of extreme cold. / A Frostbitten creature takes 1d10 cold damage at the end of their for each rank they have, if they have not spent at least half of their movement moving into a new space before the end of their turns. / A Frostbitten creature cannot cast jutsu with the Combo keyword, or benefit from a jutsu’s Chain 2 or 3 effects. / Creatures that are immune to Cold damage is immune to this condition. / A Frostbitten creature can spend an Action to make a DC 20 Dexterity ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends. |

7th Level Clan Feature

The Yuki clan has a unique talent for manifesting Ice Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Ice Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Wind or Water release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Cold respectively.

Your skills with Ice Mirrors you create has become far more prominent, garnering you the following benefits;

Ice Mirrors that you occupy can use its own AC or your AC, whichever is higher.

While not in combat, you can allow allied creatures to teleport through your Ice Mirrors through to another Ice Mirrors.

When you summon an Ice Mirror, you can have it suspended in the air, no higher than 10 feet off the ground.
